purpose: Represent project cause-and-effect relationships so Isabel can reason across schedule, RFIs, submittals, trades, locations, parties, cost exposure, evidence, and downstream consequences without collapsing inference into fact.

edge_types.CLARIFIES: document resolves or modifies another item
edge_types.MAY_AFFECT: plausible but not yet confirmed impact

causal_rules: Never convert MAY_AFFECT into AFFECTS without supporting evidence.
Schedule exposure is not a delay unless an affected path or milestone consequence is supported.
Cost exposure is not a cost change unless quantity/rate/scope evidence supports it.
Every derived consequence must retain the path of supporting nodes and edges.
Contradictory evidence remains visible until explicitly resolved.
Responsible party and decision owner are distinct concepts.
A project graph may recommend investigation or decision; it may not approve consequential actions.

example.required_unknown: Whether revised anchorage changes fabrication release status.
example.allowed_conclusion: There is schedule exposure; a delay is not yet confirmed.
